reason: A Windows-specific terminal support plugin that adds process inspection and signal handling for persistent PTY shells, including process-tree termination and reversible runtime integration.

summaries.zh: 为 Windows 上的持久化 PTY 终端提供进程监视、信号处理和进程树控制能力。
summaries.en: Adds Windows process inspection, signal handling, and process-tree control for persistent PTY terminals.

capabilities: Inspects Windows process trees and process identities through PowerShell CIM queries
Attaches to persistent PTY terminals and sends interrupt input
Terminates terminal process trees or individual processes using Windows process controls
Wraps and restores the runtime terminal-spawn function
